title: 第12章 迷雾山脉第13章 救人
content_zh:
画地为牢本来就是小冉母亲炼制给她防身用的二级符阵，她不懂阵法，除了攻击符阵消耗符阵的能量，她也是没有其他办法。
只是符阵给肖恩植入了阵基，加固了符阵强度，岂是她一时半会破得开的。
连续攻击了两天符阵，小冉终于累了，这才坐了下来，稍稍的冷静了下来，看见石墩上有一个凹槽，马上想起了布块上面的字。
“上小，上当，小彐为当，小字下面是个彐字，彐即是水，缺彐即是缺水，石墩上面有凹槽，对，用水。”
小冉本来就聪明伶俐，这么简单的问题一想就通，马上取出了水袋，将水倒进了凹槽中。
嗤！
水倒进了凹槽，凹槽中早已被肖恩震得虚浮的符纸溶解成了纸浆，符阵也是顿时消失不见了，从凹槽中升起了一条小石柱。
石柱顶上有一块散开着的布块和一团紧紧包着的小布团，小冉拿起了散开着的布块一看，连气都不敢去生了，内心中涌起了一股恐惧感。
“小再，你不生气最多困你两个时辰，现在给困了两天，滋味不好受吧，我们无仇无怨，我也不想杀你，这是摧心掌解药的药方，蛇诞草、七腥叶……”
“连服三天就会没事，你可以不信，没有人会逼你信！”
“倒霉蛋，小魔头，你是不是在这里，快给我滚出来。”
小冉恐慌的眼神扫视着四周，大声的叫喊着。
再从石柱上拿起包着的布团，布团有着一块布条捆绑着，上面写着：“你想死的话就打开看，拿回去交给你的长辈，他们会教你怎么服药。”
小冉像是个泄气的皮球一样坐在了地上，就连自己能够战胜肖恩的那一点点优越感也是荡然无存。
最可怕的是他人明明不在这里，自己的每一个动作甚至是每一个想法都是在对方的掌握中，哪里还有再拆开布团的勇气。
现在就算是肖恩说她是个男的，恐怕也得脱了裤子检查一下才能够放心了。
小冉无精打采的走出了魔兽山脉，去的地方竟然是在天绝谷的附近处。
小冉的母亲听完了小冉说的话，接过了小布团打开一看，只见上面写着：“我知道你能够看得出摧心掌是假的，你最好还是劝她乖乖的把药喝了。”
“扇我耳光，不灌她三日臭药，我咽不下去这口恶气，要是让我知道她没有喝药，我最少有一万种办法让她相信是真的。”
肖恩心恩的缜密让她惊叹不已，手段高超，步步计算精准到位，还好肖恩没有什么恶意，只是一些腥臭的药草，喝着也就是难受一点罢了。

“小冉，听娘的话，乖乖的喝三日药吧，这摧心掌是真的，以后碰上那个少年，别再去惹他了，你不是他的对手。”
她叹了口气，又爱又怜的看着女儿，自己的女儿刁蛮任性，但性情直率，日后要是真的再遇上了，没说上三句说话，就能让对方知道她有没有喝药了。
还好是自己的女儿心地善良，双方没有结怨，没有招来对方的恶意报复，想到了肖恩的手段，就凭着那能够破解符阵的手法，就足够自己的女儿吃尽苦头了。
“哦，知道了。”
前半句小冉信了，这臭药也喝定了，可听到了母亲的后半句说话，又再激起了小魔女的傲性，直接的把肖恩惦记上了。
这摧心掌算是把她的心给摧了！
“疯丫头，臭丫头，哪里跑出来的疯婆子，实力强得一塌糊涂，害得老子一路拼命的奔逃，别再让老子碰见上，看不把你娇嫩的小屁股拍个稀烂，老子就不姓……”
肖恩一边跑一边骂，骂到最后想想也是算了，没有必要为了一口恶气，把自己的祖宗也赌了上去。
跑了一天一夜，肖恩又跑进了一片大森林中。
森林中到处都是缭绕着浓浓的白雾，在这等的浓雾笼罩下，能见度极低，就连灵识都是很难渗透得了，还弥漫着冰冷的寒气，这对困乏不堪的肖恩来说，无异于雪上加霜。
最可怕的是连个兽影都是没有见得着，连最基本的温饱问题也解决不了，唯有强忍饥渴，凭着感觉一直的往前走。
“这他娘的究竟是什么鬼地方？还好是小伦不在这里，要不连饿几天，恐怕是得把我自己割肉烤给它吃了。”
想到了小伦，肖恩不由得自嘲的笑了。
而迷雾森林最可怕的并不是庞大，而是迷雾弥漫中，连天空中的阳光照射下来，都会被浓雾稀释成一片朦胧的光线，令人完全找不到方向感。
而肖恩，只能是顺着前方走去，如此，又是过了一天。
黑暗中，当迷雾森林又再亮起了微弱的光线，肖恩知道，新的一天又到来了。
“再大的森林，总有走完的时候吧！”
一路向前奔掠，肖恩舔了舔干燥的嘴唇，喃喃的声音，悄然响起。
content_en:
Drawing the ground as a prison was originally a second-level talisman array refined by Xiaoran's mother for her to use for self-defense. She didn't understand the array, so she had no other choice but to attack the talisman array and consume the energy of the talisman array.
It's just that the talisman array implanted a formation base into Xiao En, strengthening the strength of the talisman array. How could she be able to break it in a short while?
After attacking the talisman array for two days in a row, Xiao Ran finally got tired. He sat down and calmed down a little. When he saw a groove on the stone pier, he immediately remembered the words on the cloth.
"If you go up to the small one, you will be fooled. The small word "彐" means "彐". Below the small letter is the word "彐", which means water. The lack of "彐" means lack of water. There are grooves on the stone pier, yes, water."
Xiaoran was already smart and could figure out such a simple problem immediately. He immediately took out the water bag and poured the water into the groove.
laugh!
The water poured into the groove, and the talisman paper in the groove that had been shaken by Sean dissolved into pulp. The talisman array also disappeared immediately, and a small stone pillar rose from the groove.
There was a loose piece of cloth and a tightly wrapped small ball of cloth on the top of the stone pillar. Xiaoran picked up the loose piece of cloth and took a look. He didn't even dare to get angry, and there was a sense of fear in his heart.
"Xiao Zai, if you don't get angry, I'll sleep you for two hours at most. Now I've been stuck for two days. It feels uncomfortable. We have no grudges, and I don't want to kill you. This is the prescription for the antidote to the Heart-Destroying Palm, Snake Grass, Qixingye..."
"If you take it for three days, you'll be fine. You don't have to believe it, no one will force you to believe it!"
"Unlucky little devil, are you here? Get out of here."
Xiao Ran glanced around with panic eyes and shouted loudly.
Then he picked up the wrapped cloth ball from the stone pillar. The cloth ball was tied with a piece of cloth and it said: "If you want to die, open it and read it. Take it back and give it to your elders. They will teach you how to take the medicine."
Xiao Ran sat on the ground like a frustrated rubber ball, and even the little sense of superiority that he could defeat Sean was gone.
The most terrifying thing is that the other person is clearly not here, and every move and even every thought is in the control of the other person. How can I still have the courage to unwrap the ball?
Now even if Sean said she was a boy, he would probably have to take off his pants and check before he could rest assured.
Xiao Ran walked out of the Warcraft Mountains listlessly, and the place he went to turned out to be near Tianjue Valley.
After listening to what Xiao Ran said, Xiao Ran's mother took the little cloth and opened it, and saw it read: "I know you can tell that Heart Destroying Palm is fake. You'd better persuade her to drink the medicine obediently."
"Slap me in the face. If I don't give her three days of stinky medicine, I won't be able to swallow this bad breath. If I know that she didn't take the medicine, I will have at least 10,000 ways to make her believe it is true."
She was amazed by Sean Xin'en's meticulousness, his superb methods, and precise calculations every step of the way. Fortunately, Sean didn't have any ill intentions, it was just some smelly herbs, which made it a little uncomfortable to drink.
"Xiao Ran, listen to mother and just drink the medicine for three days. This heart-destroying palm is real. If you meet that boy in the future, don't mess with him again. You are no match for him."
She sighed and looked at her daughter with love and pity. Her daughter was unruly and willful, but had a straightforward temperament. If she really met her again in the future, she would be able to let the other person know whether she had taken medicine without even saying a few words.
Fortunately, his daughter was kind-hearted, and there was no grudge between the two parties, nor any malicious revenge from the other party. Thinking of Sean's method, his ability to break the talisman array was enough for his daughter to suffer.
"Oh, got it."
Xiao Ran believed the first half of the sentence, and was sure to drink the bad medicine, but hearing the second half of her mother's words aroused the little witch's pride again, and she immediately missed Sean.
This heart-breaking palm had broken her heart!
"Crazy girl, stinky girl, crazy woman who ran out of nowhere, she's so powerful that she's so dangerousYou have to run as fast as you can, don’t let me run into you again, if you don’t want to slap your delicate little butt to a pulp, I won’t give up..."
Sean scolded him as he ran, and finally thought about it and let it go. There was no need to risk his ancestors just for a bad breath.
After running for a day and a night, Sean ran into a large forest again.
Thick white fog is lingering everywhere in the forest. Under such thick fog, visibility is extremely low, and even spiritual consciousness is difficult to penetrate. There is also an icy cold air, which is nothing more than adding insult to injury to the sleepy Sean.
The most terrifying thing is that there is not even a shadow of the beast in sight, and even the most basic food and clothing problems cannot be solved. I can only endure my hunger and thirst and keep moving forward based on my feelings.
“What the hell is this place? Fortunately, Xiao Lun is not here. If I hadn't been hungry for several days, I would have had to cut my own flesh and roast it for it to eat. "
Thinking of Xiao Lun, Sean couldn't help but laugh to himself.
The most terrifying thing about the foggy forest is not that it is huge, but that it is filled with fog. Even the sunlight in the sky will be diluted by the thick fog into a hazy light, making people completely lose their sense of direction.
As for Sean, he could only walk along the front, and like this, another day passed.
In the darkness, when the misty forest lit up with faint light again, Sean knew that a new day had arrived.
“No matter how big the forest is, it will eventually come to an end! "
Running forward, Sean licked his dry lips and murmured quietly.
